blurb: The maid nobody looked at hatched the egg nobody could, then walked into a dragon rider academy full of people about to regret every word.
Ivy has the voice, her best friend has the credit, and the whole school is about to hear who was really singing.
Everyone in the house wants Clara to stop talking, except the little boy who hasn't said a word in two years and is finally starting to listen.
Isolde saves her husband's life, and Mark is sure she was trying to end it. Then he makes her pay for it.
